title: Novaris theme.json
description: Metadata for a Novaris theme. This is not the WordPress theme.json format.

$schema.description: The schema for this file, for editor autocomplete and validation.

name.description: Theme name shown to people, such as "Amicable".

slug.description: Theme folder name. It must match the GitHub repository name, because themes install into themes/{slug} and release zips are named {slug}.{version}.zip.

version.description: Theme version, without a leading v. `novaris theme:update` compares it with the latest GitHub release tag.

repository.description: GitHub repository that updates come from, as owner/slug. Needed for `novaris theme:update`.

parent.description: Parent theme to inherit templates and config from. A slug installs from novaris-dev; owner/slug installs from that GitHub user or organization.

supports.description: Features the theme supports. A feature is on when its value is true or an object of settings.

default.description: URL of the default header image.
